description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment, Aththidiya South,Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District   - Cad. Map No.  521002
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration and amendment under the Registration of Title Act. It specifically deals with updating the ownership records for a particular parcel of land (No. 125 of Block 05) by inserting new owner information including name, address, national identity card number, and co-ownership details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement, confirming it is primarily concerned with land and property matters.
